units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:4">Ab. I, 4</cite> let thy house be <he>בית ו׳ וכ׳</he> a meeting place for scholars.—Esp. <he>בית ו׳</he>

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:33">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>למחר … לבית הו׳</he> to-morrow, when I come to college &c. Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ bot. <he>עושים לו בית ו׳</he> you must provide a school-house for him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49b:2">49ᵇ</cite>) <he>ב׳ ו׳ יהיה וכ׳</he> the school-house will be used for debauchery.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:10">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>; a. fr.—
